faqs.a:
The city manager shall appoint a director for each administrative department. The
               city manager may appoint an acting director of an administrative department for a
               period not exceeding 12 months. A director or acting director of any administrative
               department shall serve at the pleasure of the city manager. The city manager shall
               be authorized to fix reasonable terms of compensation and benefits for department
               directors, including their participation in the city sponsored 457 Deferred Compensation
               Plan and the city sponsored Retirement Health Savings Plan.
(Code 1981, § 2-100; Ord. No. 2065, § 3, 5-21-1984; Ord. No. 3613, § 1, 5-1-2000;
Ord. No. 4035, § 1, 12-11-2006
)
